verdict.rationale: The Inference API docs say clients are available for the Connect, gRPC, and Protobuf ecosystems and that users can install generated clients. That points to a schema-driven, Protobuf-based API definition, but nothing in the evidence shows the spec itself (OpenAPI file or .proto definitions) can be downloaded. The CKS API reference is documented only as prose, and llms.txt is a docs index, not an API spec. Missing for 10: an explicit downloadable OpenAPI or Protobuf spec file, spec coverage beyond the Inference API (CKS, storage, billing), and independent or hands-on confirmation.
